provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the nightshades work (2026-10-17): every character from the floras in the nightshades notes (plantgen-claude project-files/nightshades/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Brugmansia suaveolens, plant_name_id 2684019 (Library 1.0 list, read 2026-10-17).

growth_form.note: Its habit as the floras describe it, drawn by the shrub form.

growth.note: Grown to the age it is drawn at: an annual's one season, a perennial's or shrub's few years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Drawing values no character gives (nightshades, 2026-10-17): a trunk of a few stems (Wikipedia: often a many-branched trunk).

allometry.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): 3-5 m; Bailey (vol. 2 p. 971, as Datura suaveolens): 10-15 ft. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 4.0 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): a semi-woody shrub or small tree.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): 3-5 m; Bailey (vol. 2 p. 971, as Datura suaveolens): 10-15 ft.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): leaves oval; Bailey: ovate-oblong.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Datura suaveolens, p. 971 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves entire, glabrous, petioled, often unequal at the base.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Datura suaveolens, p. 971 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 6-12 in long; Wikipedia: up to 25 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): up to 15 cm wide; Bailey: 2.5-4 in (partly unreadable).

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: evergreen.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Datura suaveolens, p. 971 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla tube plaited, with a limb of 5 short lobes; Wikipedia: trumpet-shaped.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: flower mouth 10-15 cm across.

traits.corolla_tube_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): trumpet 24-32 cm long, its 5 points short, 1-2.5 cm; Bailey (vol. 2 p. 971, as Datura suaveolens): flowers 9-12 in long.

traits.flower_posture.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): flowers fully pendulous to nearly horizontal; Bailey (vol. 2 p. 971): among the tall Daturas with pendulous blossoms.

traits.flower_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Brugmansia suaveolens' (read 2026-10-17): usually white, sometimes yellow or pink. The colour is our reading of the word.

traits.fruit_type.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a fleshy, unspined fruit (Wikipedia 'Brugmansia': fruit without spines).

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: fruit 10-15 cm long.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: iNaturalist observation 39560425 (CC-licensed photograph, viewed 2026-10-17): long spindle-shaped green fruit hang. No text read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: in flower from July to October where it is grown outdoors in a temperate summer: Bailey (vol. 2, Datura, culture) has the woody daturas grown outdoors in summer in the North and stored in cellars over winter, almost everblooming in the South; no source gives months.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: fruit set after the first flowers, from September; in cultivation it seldom fruits.
